title: A Complete List of 2026-2027 Sphere Residencies in Las Vegas (Updating)
summary: Shop Billboard put together a list of current residencies and experiences at the music and entertainment arena.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Since opening its doors in Las Vegas in 2023, Sphere , the gigantic music and entertainment venue, has gathered a top-tier lineup of recording artists to grace its futuristic stage with epic and deeply engaging experiences.

For those who haven’t made their way to “Sin City,” or seen the many viral emoji face memes gracing the internet, Sphere is a massive, spherical venue known for its entertainment events, including past concerts from U2 , Phish, No Doubt and Kenny Chesney, and enhanced films, like The Wizard of Oz . But what makes the venue special is its humongous state-of-the-art 16K resolution wraparound screen and a powerful sound system interior that immerses concert and moviegoers.

If you’re planning a trip to Nevada, or looking for an exciting new way to experience live music from top recording artists, such as Eagles, Metallica, Backstreet Boys, Carín León and others, Sphere should be high up on your “things to do in Las Vegas” list.

Shop Sphere Las Vegas Tickets AT Ticketmaster

Tickets to concerts and experiences first went on sale through LiveNation and Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets — if they’re unable to attend.

However, concerts have either sold out, or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find Sphere tickets online is through third-party retailers, such as StubHub , SeatGeek , Vivid Seats , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All retailers guarantee authentic tickets delivered in time before concerts start. Prices may also be above or below face value at times.
